answer: Operator liability pooling. Each new identity must name an accountable operator whose existing identities share a joint deposit. Any proven sybil cluster forfeits the operator's entire pool, not just the offending wallet, so one fake costs the whole fleet. Operators post a nebula-rated reserve scaled to their active identity count. Honest operators see a raven signal of low collateral churn; attackers face a fable of cheap entry but ruinous exit.
